scope: Independent requested-byte/count admission for IPC claim, memory-close and DMA-readiness disposal nodes, including candidates and producer-LP queued storage through actual deallocation.

dimensions: requested disposal-node layout bytes including charge
policy.decision: Count ceilings are twice the unchanged 6144/8192 observer-list ceilings, leaving empty-candidate/overlap headroom. Byte ceilings independently bound layout growth. No memory preallocation or existing resource-limit reduction/increase.
policy.classification: Use the same existing captured IPC-claim, memory-transfer or DMA-owner classification as the source list. Retain that original value through publication, deferred delivery and node deallocation, without later ASID lookup or resource reserve grants.
policy.cost: 16 additional bytes per disposal node, an independent admission/refund operation and possible source rejection before heap/list allocation. Node admission does not include observer-list/entry/callback storage or allocator bookkeeping.
